newsitem.title: USA: Harsco Corp to begin operations in China.
newsitem.headline: Harsco Corp to begin operations in China.

text.p: Harsco Corp said on Thursday that it planned to establish manufacturing operations in Beijing, China, under a joint venture formed through its Taylor-Wharton Gas Equipment Division.
The facility will be operated by Taylor-Wharton Cryogenic Equipment Co Ltd, a joint venture formed with Beijing Metal Construction Works, Harsco said.
Using an existing BMCW plant, production is scheduled to begin later this year on cryogenic bulk tanks for industrial gases, Harsco said.
"The rapidly growing demand for industrial gases in China and the Pacific Rim is generating correspondingly strong markets for gas containment equipment," said Harsco chief executive Derek Hathaway.

"Having operations within that market, close to our customers, allows us to respond quickly and effectively, and further enhances our ability to capture a major share of the anticipated growth," he added.
Harsco Corp is an industrial services and products company with 350 locations worldwide.
